actionCalls.description: Sends the Ticket Office Agreement Details email alert for the Opportunity linked to this Adobe Sign agreement.
actionCalls.name: Send_Ticket_Office_Email
actionCalls.label: Send Ticket Office Email

actionCalls.description: Customer signed: sends the same Ticket Office email from Apex with the signed PDF from the Adobe agreement attached.
actionCalls.name: Send_Signed_Email_With_PDF
actionCalls.label: Send Signed Email With PDF

Flow.description: Notifies the Ticket Office (and Sales Manager) when: (1) the Sales Manager approves or declines in Adobe Sign (approval status to Out for Signature / Approved / Cancelled-Declined); (2) first send of an agreement with a total of $50k or more (pre-send status to Out for Approval / Out for Signature); (3) the customer signs (Signed - sent by TicketOfficeSignedEmail with the signed PDF attached) or declines (signature status to Cancelled-Declined). Total uses the same field per Agreement Type as the email.

formulas.description: Agreement total from the linked Opportunity, using the same field per Agreement Type as the email.
formulas.name: frmAgreementTotal

formulas.description: Point 3 (declined): customer declined while the agreement was out for signature. Signed is handled by the Customer_Signed outcome.
formulas.name: frmCustomerSignedOrDeclined
formulas.expression: AND( OR(TEXT({!$Record__Prior.echosign_dev1__Status__c}) = "Out for Signature", TEXT({!$Record__Prior.echosign_dev1__Status__c}) = "Waiting for Counter-Signature"), TEXT({!$Record.echosign_dev1__Status__c}) = "Cancelled / Declined")

formulas.description: Point 1: Sales Manager approved (approval status to Out for Signature / Approved) or declined (approval status to Cancelled / Declined).
formulas.name: frmManagerApprovedOrDeclined
formulas.expression: AND( OR(TEXT({!$Record__Prior.echosign_dev1__Status__c}) = "Out for Approval", TEXT({!$Record__Prior.echosign_dev1__Status__c}) = "Waiting for Counter-Approval"), OR(TEXT({!$Record.echosign_dev1__Status__c}) = "Out for Signature", TEXT({!$Record.echosign_dev1__Status__c}) = "Approved", TEXT({!$Record.echosign_dev1__Status__c}) = "Cancelled / Declined"))

formulas.description: Point 2: first send of an agreement with a total of $50k or more - the status leaves a pre-send status (Draft / Pre-Send / Send in Progress / Created) for its first live status (Out for Approval, or Out for Signature when there is no approver). Later re-entries into Out for Approval do not re-notify.
formulas.name: frmSentAt50kOrMore
formulas.expression: AND( OR(TEXT({!$Record__Prior.echosign_dev1__Status__c}) = "Draft", TEXT({!$Record__Prior.echosign_dev1__Status__c}) = "Pre-Send", TEXT({!$Record__Prior.echosign_dev1__Status__c}) = "Send in Progress", TEXT({!$Record__Prior.echosign_dev1__Status__c}) = "Created", ISBLANK(TEXT({!$Record__Prior.echosign_dev1__Status__c}))), OR(TEXT({!$Record.echosign_dev1__Status__c}) = "Out for Approval", TEXT({!$Record.echosign_dev1__Status__c}) = "Out for Signature"), {!frmAgreementTotal} >= 50000)

Flow.label: Adobe Agreement - Notify Ticket Office
